tests.name: short_ascii_strings_boundary_32
tests.intent: Verify serialization output of printable ASCII strings exactly at, below, and above the 32-byte threshold.

tests.name: short_strings_with_escapes
tests.intent: Verify serialization of short strings containing characters that require escaping like quotes and backslashes.

tests.name: short_strings_ensure_ascii
tests.intent: Verify short strings serialization with ensure_ascii set to true containing both plain and non-ASCII characters.

tests.name: object_keys_short_string_optimization
tests.intent: Verify that object keys around the 32-byte boundary serialize correctly under compact and pretty formats.

tests.name: empty_and_single_char_strings
tests.intent: Verify edge cases of empty and single character strings for dump optimization.

tests.name: ascii_control_characters_in_short_strings
tests.intent: Verify that control characters embedded in short strings correctly trigger escaping mechanisms.

tests.name: pretty_printing_indentation_inlining
tests.intent: Verify that pretty printing with specific indentation levels works correctly with short string optimization.

tests.name: ordered_json_short_strings
tests.intent: Verify nlohmann::ordered_json correctly dumps short strings and preserves insertion order.

tests.name: mixed_length_array_dump
tests.intent: Verify serialization of an array containing strings of varied lengths spanning above and below the 32-byte boundary.

tests.name: high_ascii_bytes_serialization
tests.intent: Verify handling of bytes in the upper range (128-255) within short strings.

tests.name: serializer_direct_dump_escaped
tests.intent: Directly exercise serializer::dump_escaped through an output stream adapter.

tests.name: deeply_nested_short_strings
tests.intent: Verify correct dumping of short strings inside deeply nested JSON structures.

tests.name: stream_operator_dump_short_strings
tests.intent: Verify output streaming operators with JSON objects containing short strings.

tests.name: to_string_free_function
tests.intent: Verify nlohmann::to_string works identically with optimized short string serialization.

tests.name: unprintable_ascii_boundary_test
tests.intent: Verify strings containing characters just below space (0x20) and just above tilde (0x7E).

tests.name: multibyte_utf8_sequence_short_string
tests.intent: Verify handling of multi-byte UTF-8 sequences within the 32-byte short string path.

tests.name: huge_number_of_short_strings
tests.intent: Verify batch serialization of many short strings in an array performs correctly.

tests.name: string_view_like_inputs
tests.intent: Verify json construction and dumping from string types and literals.

tests.name: null_bytes_inside_short_strings
tests.intent: Verify serialization of short strings containing embedded null characters.

tests.name: exact_32_byte_printable_string
tests.intent: Verify a string precisely 32 bytes long containing only copyable ASCII characters.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise put_indent by pretty-printing an object or array containing short strings, guaranteeing execution of the inlined put_indent function.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise put_literal by serializing a structured JSON object with various types, causing literal components like null, true, false, or braces to be emitted via put_literal.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise ascii_copyable lookup table and dump_escaped check explicitly by serializing a short printable ASCII string via stream operator with pretty formatting, ensuring ascii_copyable() and put_indent/put_literal are all invoked.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise ascii_copyable with non-copyable bytes such as quotes or control characters inside short strings using pretty printing to hit the copyable table initialization and the pretty printing indentation loops.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercise ascii_copyable initialization and put_indent/put_literal paths with an array of short strings under pretty-printing indentation.

tests.name: serializer_direct_dump_escaped_fixed
tests.intent: Directly exercise serializer::dump_escaped through an output stream adapter.
